```
tool.broadcast.show(big)
```

| Name | Type | Meaning and accepted values |
|---|---|---|
| `big` | `int` | argument; 1..3; BIG number |

Returns `Reply`: `big` (int), `state` (str), `broadcast_id` (hex), `name` (str), `encrypted` (bool), `pbp` (str), `subgroups` (int), `bis` (int), `phy` (str), `interval_us` (int), `rtn` (int), `sdu` (int), `pa_ms` (int), `airtime_us` (int), `fits` (bool), `bn` (int), `iso_interval_us` (int).

Data `SUBGROUP`: `sg` (int), `preset` (str), `rate` (int), `frame_us` (int), `octets` (int), `lang` (str), `ctx` (str), `program` (str), `bis` (int).

Data `BIS`: `bis` (int), `sg` (int), `location` (str), `cfg` (str), `rate` (int), `octets` (int), `tone` (int), `freq_actual` (float), `level` (int), `level_actual` (float), `sent` (int).

## `broadcast start`

Start the BIG (result: broadcast_started)

Example:

```
tool.broadcast.start(big, force=True)
```

| Name | Type | Meaning and accepted values |
|---|---|---|
| `big` | `int` | argument; 1..3; BIG number |
| `force` | `bool` | option; start anyway next to BIGs of another interval or past the air time budget (frames will be lost) |

Returns `Reply`: `big` (int), `state` (str), `broadcast_id` (hex).

## `broadcast stop`

Stop the BIG; its configuration stays (state stopped)

Example:

```
tool.broadcast.stop(big)
```

| Name | Type | Meaning and accepted values |
|---|---|---|
| `big` | `int` | argument; 1..3; BIG number |

Returns `Reply`: `big` (int), `state` (str).

## `broadcast restart`

Stop and start the BIG

Example:

```
tool.broadcast.restart(big, force=True)
```

| Name | Type | Meaning and accepted values |
|---|---|---|
| `big` | `int` | argument; 1..3; BIG number |
| `force` | `bool` | option; start anyway next to BIGs of another interval or past the air time budget (frames will be lost) |

Returns `Reply`: `big` (int), `state` (str), `broadcast_id` (hex).
